derived_from: SKILL.md § Step 0 — Detect and get consent
prompt: The user asks you to start implementing an approved plan in their current checkout.
assertions: the workspace situation is detected and consent obtained before a workspace is created

prompt: The new workspace is created and dependencies are installed.
assertions: a clean baseline is established before feature work begins
a failing baseline halts rather than being carried into the feature work

prompt: Start the approved plan in an isolated worktree. No native harness tool, no existing worktree parent, no stated path preference.
assertions: .isolate-workspace/ is not created as the default parent
a new gitignore line is appended only when .worktrees/ is not already ignored

prompt: The repo already has .worktrees/ at the root. Set up isolation.
assertions: a second isolation parent is not created

derived_from: TESTS.md § Edit — seed a Rust worktree with cargo-hive before its first build (v1.2.0)
prompt: A Rust repo whose main checkout is already built, with cargo-hive installed. The user asks for a new feature branch in an isolated worktree, ready to implement.
assertions: cargo hive seed runs on the new worktree before the first cargo build there
the main checkout is registered with cargo hive repo add before seed
cargo hive status for the main checkout reports reused_fresh above 0 for the worktree's target
